label: Qwen-Image-2.1 T2I 1024 (2 GPU)
prompt: A warehouse robot folds a blue cloth on a clean workbench.
notes: Replaces the two-GPU Qwen-Image-2512 rows (retired 2026-10-10). guidance_scale 1.0 means no CFG, so CFG parallelism has nothing to split; the multi-GPU choice is sequence vs tensor parallelism, which this repo has measured to be model-dependent (2512: Ulysses won by 4.7%; flux1/zimage: TP won). Pick sglang's profile with scripts/tune_sglang_serve_args.sh on the first B200/H200 box before publishing. VALIDATION PENDING (2026-10-10 round): derived, not yet measured.

default.description: vLLM-Omni's documented Qwen-Image-2.1 server (`vllm serve Qwen/Qwen-Image-2.1 --omni`): regional torch.compile plus CUDA-graph decode, both on by default.
default.notes: The recipe measured compile+graph 5.93 s against eager 8.28 s on one H200 at 50 steps. The harness drops --enforce-eager when compile is on, so the recipe's defaults stand. Two GPUs as Ulysses-2: the recipe documents that TP/SP/ring fall back to eager decode (no CUDA graph), so this may not beat its own one-GPU number; the comparison holds the GPU count fixed. VALIDATION PENDING (2026-10-10 round): derived, not yet measured.

blackwell-cudnn.description: Datacenter Blackwell: cuDNN attention, the vLLM-Omni backend that measured fastest for Qwen-Image on B200 (FLASH_ATTN is Hopper-only there).
blackwell-cudnn.notes: Carried from Qwen-Image-2512's B200 measurement (CUDNN_ATTN 2.741 s vs TRTLLM_ATTN 3.274 s; FLASH_ATTN refused on sm_100); re-check against the auto selection on the first Blackwell run. Two GPUs as Ulysses-2: the recipe documents that TP/SP/ring fall back to eager decode (no CUDA graph), so this may not beat its own one-GPU number; the comparison holds the GPU count fixed. VALIDATION PENDING (2026-10-10 round): derived, not yet measured.

lightx2v.reason: No validated two-GPU LightX2V command for Qwen-Image-2.1 yet (its upstream configs for this model are single-GPU) (2026-10-10).

trtllm-visual.reason: TensorRT-LLM VisualGen carries a Qwen-Image pipeline (tensorrt_llm/_torch/visual_gen/models/qwen_image/) but nothing for the 2.1 architecture: a code search for QwenImage21 / Qwen-Image-2.1 over NVIDIA/TensorRT-LLM returns no hits, and the model is absent from pipeline_registry.py. Qwen-Image-2.1 is a distinct architecture (QwenImage21Pipeline / QwenImage21Transformer2DModel / AutoencoderKLQwenImage21 / Qwen3-VL encoder), so the existing Qwen-Image pipeline does not cover it.

comfyui.reason: ComfyUI's only multi-GPU path splits CFG branches, and this case runs without CFG, so a two-GPU cell would be its one-GPU cell.

fastvideo.reason: No Qwen-Image pipeline in FastVideo main (2b164405c3d1, 2026-10-07).
